## Fix these

### Critical 1 — relative spin rotation
`targetWheelRotationDeg` in `app/src/game/spin.ts` must take current rotation and always add fresh full turns:
`currentRotationDeg - (currentRotationDeg % 360) + extraTurns*360 + offset`
Update `turnReducer` to pass `state.rotationDeg` into the spin target builder.
Add a Vitest regression: two successive spins (with mocked rng) produce a rotation delta ≥ ~4*360 (or ≥ SPIN_EXTRA_TURNS*360 - small tolerance).

### Critical 2 — show host errors + enough questions for demos
- Render `state.error` visibly in `TurnScreen.tsx` (banner/message for host).
- Expand `QUESTIONS` fixture to at least **80** items (can duplicate/variant short Scout Q&A text with unique ids 1..80+) so 10 rounds × 8 clans don't exhaust mid-demo. Keep respuestaCorrecta present but never show it in UI.

### Important — projector layout
In `app/src/index.css` (or App.css), ensure `#root { width: 100%; max-width: none; border: none; }` (override Vite scaffold 1126px).

## Do NOT
- Implement timer/score/host panel
- Change product rules beyond above

## Verify
- npm test (must pass, include new rotation test)
- npm run build
